# Erdős #1193 - Knowledge Base

## Problem Statement

Let $A\subset \mathbb{N}$ and let $g(n)$ be a non-decreasing function of $n$ which is always $>0$. 

Is the lower density of
$$\{ n : 1_A\ast 1_A(n)=g(n)\}$$
always $0$? Is the upper density always $<c$ for some constant $c<1$?
